· Position vs SMA100/200($84.56/$85.45) — Mid-to-long-term trend weakness confirmed.
· 52-week Position (10.8%) + Current price range historically near the low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (35.5→44.5) + Exiting oversold, entering neutral zone confirmed.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.0789→-0.0188) + Improvement diagnosed, in bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $83.28) + Bandwidth 3.18% interpreted as normal.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($82.77) + Basis (SMA20, 5-day low based).
· Swing Resistance ($84.34) + Potential mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low confirmed, range-bound continuation) + Recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.73x) + Low confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) + Wait-and-see conditions confirmed.
